title: OpenAI 宣布达到自动化研究实习生里程碑，内部 agent 运行时达人力 3.1 倍

title: OpenAI 长文阐述对齐与监测困境，称 CoT 监控能力正在减弱
summary: OpenAI 发布长文《An Alien Mind》，回溯 2023 年 RLSlow 项目中确认推理模型可扩展训练的起点，并系统阐述目标对齐与价值对齐的区分。文章指出链式思维监控的效果正随着模型能力提升而逐步减弱，GPT-6 Astra 在对齐上显著优于 GPT-5.6 Sol；作者预期进展可能持续走向机器递归自我改进（RSI），呼吁自愿放缓扩展、建立第三方安全门槛并加强国际协调。

Cuts tokens by up to 88%, cost by up to 66%, boosts accuracy up to 7%, biggest wins on long-form video. Live now via Gemini API in AI Studio and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, just set processing to "agentic," standard pricing, no extra fee.

title: Kit by Speakeasy
summary: Your coding agent runtime. Claude but fast, cheap, concise.
body: Kit is a coding agent runtime. It gives the model one tool for writing and running programs. Kit provides a terminal client, an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server, an A2A endpoint, and a subagent orchestrator in one static binary. ACP separates agent clients from agent runtimes, so Kit works in compatible editors and can orchestrate other harnesses without custom integrations.
